edbDesc: Birefringence, or double refraction, is the decomposition of a ray of light into two rays (the ordinary ray and the extraordinary ray) when it passes through certain types of material, such as calcite crystals or boron nitride, depending on the polarisation of the light. This effect can occur only if the structure of the material is anisotropic (directionally dependent).
title: Birefringence
